listed_sector_signals.signal: On-site nitrogen generation process installed at a facility (industrial gas), described as a non-routine adjustment case
listed_sector_signals.quote:
An inhouse nitrogen generation 
process was installed to replace daily nitrogen deliveries.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Generic mention of a plant shifting from batch to continuous operation as an example of a major process change
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Some of the examples of a major process change can relate
to a shift in plant operations from batch-type to continuous

one_line: A methodology/literature review on standardizing measurement-and-verification non-routine adjustments for static factors, illustrated with SEP/ISO 50001 case studies from mostly discrete manufacturing facilities (welding, machining, paint lines, presses), not continuous-flow production.
